top_categories.workout_context: In Flanders Fields Cyclo - Wevelgem's coastal roads forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 139 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic In Flanders Fields Cyclo - Wevelgem's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
At mile 60 of 139, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
In Flanders Fields Cyclo - Wevelgem's coastal roads rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At In Flanders Fields Cyclo - Wevelgem, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
When someone attacks on coastal roads, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of In Flanders Fields Cyclo - Wevelgem. Train it until it feels boring.
At In Flanders Fields Cyclo - Wevelgem, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on coastal roads. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,609ft of climbing on coastal roads does to your power file on race day.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 139 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Smooth pedaling at 139 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for In Flanders Fields Cyclo - Wevelgem’s 139 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Highly technical terrain at In Flanders Fields Cyclo - Wevelgem demands practice on similar surfaces. Ride coastal roads at race-day cadence weekly. Practice cornering, descending, and power delivery on unstable surfaces. Test tires and pressure in comparable conditions before race week rather than guessing from a generic time-loss claim.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and Durability to prepare you for 139 miles of coastal roads in Wevelgem, West Flanders, Belgium.
